title: Finite primary decomposition of Noetherian ideals
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Every ideal $I\subseteq R$ is a finite intersection of primary ideals. An ideal $Q$ is primary if $Q\ne R$ and $xy\in Q$, $x\notin Q$ imply $y^n\in Q$ for some integer $n\geq1$. The empty intersection is $R$, so the assertion includes the unit ideal.
